caption: Magnetic tiles are stacked one onto another, and each tile clicks onto the last and the tower stands.

sa.check: The tiles are stacked one onto another.
Each tile clicks onto the last.
The tiles are flat pieces stacked face to face or edge to edge.
Each tile is placed after the one before it.

pc.expect: As each tile nears the stack it is drawn over the last small gap into place and stays there; the stack holds together as it is built and if lifted.
pc.fail: A tile stops a gap short of the stack and rests there; or slides off after touching; or the stack falls apart when a tile is added; or the stack is lifted and the lower tiles stay behind.

pc.expect: The tower stands on the table under its own weight; a tile that is knocked loose falls downward.
pc.fail: The tower floats above the table; or a tile hovers beside the stack without touching; or a loose tile rises; or the tower leans far past its base and stands.

pc.expect: Tiles move only in the hand and over the last small gap; once placed they stay put and the tower does not shift by itself.
pc.fail: A tile jumps to the stack from far away; or tiles rearrange themselves after placing; or the tower slides across the table; or a placed tile spins in place.

pc.expect: The tiles are rigid flat pieces that keep their shape; they meet face to face without deforming.
pc.fail: A tile bends or flexes; or tiles squash together; or a tile stretches; or the tiles flow into one another.

pc.expect: The tiles in the tower are the tiles that were placed, one at a time; none appear from nowhere, vanish or merge; the tower does not pass through the table.
pc.fail: Tiles appear in the tower that were not placed; or a tile vanishes; or two tiles merge into one thick piece; or the tower sinks into the table.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tiles' colours and shapes and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: A tile changes colour once placed; or a tile changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The click is sound and is not judged.
